verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs say it can automatically parse incoming emails and route them via rules and webhooks, so inbound mail is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single marketing-level line, though. It does not document MX setup, which parsed fields are delivered, or any inbound API. Missing for 10: documented MX record configuration, an explicit parsed payload schema (headers, body, attachments), API retrieval of inbound messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive email — point MX records at the service and get parsed messages (headers, body, attachments) delivered to my webhook or API

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
